name: show_party_status_ui

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_ShowPartyStatusUi takes no Script context, clears bit 3 of D_002C1EA8, and does not access the value stack

notes: The registered interface callback func_0023E2B8 mirrors D_002C1EA8 bit 3 and, when the bit clears, transitions each of the three indexed party-status components through func_0023E0B0 to display state 2. Setting the bit through command 113 transitions the same components to hidden state 3. The JP corpus contains 299 calls; 199 follow finish_event_mode and 268 share an entry with command 114 enable_player_control.
